name: The Index
summary: The Lattice's first line: seal a Weft leak in the Shards and report it filed. The Index begins with one entry, and ends with a Key.

leak.summary: Archivist Tal has marked a Weft leak in the Shards. Seal it with the Lattice kit.

objectives.text: Seal the marked Weft leak in a Shard

report.summary: Report the leak to Archivist Tal in the enclave.

objectives.text: Report to Archivist Tal in the Lattice enclave

done.summary: Filed. The Index has a Key's position: under the Ghost Markets, in the echo where the Choir keeps its ledgers.
